sql.ahj.design.detailByAhj: SELECT d.*, ahj.metro_area_id, ahj.name as ahj_name, cs.state_id, s.state AS "stateName" FROM brs.ahj_design d INNER JOIN brs.ahj ahj ON ahj.id = d.ahj_id LEFT JOIN flow.list_of_value lov ON lov.id = ahj.metro_area_id left join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = ahj.company_state_id left join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id WHERE d.ahj_id = :ahjId
sql.ahj.design.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_design(ahj_id, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id) VALUES (:ahjId, now(), :currentUser, now(), :currentUser)
sql.ahj.design.searchAhjsByState: SELECT d.id, d.ahj_id FROM brs.ahj_design d INNER JOIN brs.ahj ahj ON ahj.id = d.ahj_id LEFT JOIN flow.list_of_value lov ON lov.id = ahj.metro_area_id left join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = ahj.company_state_id WHERE cs.state_id = :stateId AND ahj.archived IS FALSE
